description: Manages linux user to SELinux user mapping.

parameters.name: ignore_selinux_state
parameters.description: Run independent of selinux runtime state. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: reload
parameters.description: Reload SELinux policy after commit. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: selevel
parameters.description: MLS/MCS Security Range (MLS/MCS Systems only) SELinux Range for SELinux login mapping defaults to the SELinux user record range. Default: "s0"

examples:
- name: Modify the default user on the system to the guest_u user
  community.general.selogin:
    login: __default__
    seuser: guest_u
    state: present

- name: Assign gijoe user on an MLS machine a range and to the staff_u user
  community.general.selogin:
    login: gijoe
    seuser: staff_u
    serange: SystemLow-Secret
    state: present

- name: Assign all users in the engineering group to the staff_u user
  community.general.selogin:
    login: '%engineering'
    seuser: staff_u
    state: present
